post.description:
Image editing with Seedream 5.0 Pro

:::tip
The first input image is free; each additional input image adds a fee. For current prices, see [kie.ai/pricing](https://kie.ai/pricing).
:::

## Query Task Status

After submitting a task, use the unified query endpoint to check progress and retrieve results:

<Card title="Get Task Details" icon="lucide-search" href="/market/common/get-task-detail">
  Learn how to query task status and retrieve generation results
</Card>

::: tip[]
For production use, we recommend using the `callBackUrl` parameter to receive automatic notifications when generation completes, rather than polling the status endpoint.
:::

model.description:
The model name to use for generation. Required field.

- Must be `seedream/5-pro-image-to-image` for this endpoint

callBackUrl.description:
The URL to receive generation task completion updates. Optional but recommended for production use.

- System will POST task status and results to this URL when generation completes
- Callback includes generated content URLs and task information
- Your callback endpoint should accept POST requests with JSON payload containing results
- Alternatively, use the Get Task Details endpoint to poll task status
- To ensure callback security, see [Webhook Verification Guide](/common-api/webhook-verification) for signature verification implementation

input.description: Input parameters for the generation task

examples: Keep the model's pose and the flowing shape of the liquid dress unchanged. Change the clothing material from silver metal to completely transparent clear water (or glass). Through the liquid water, the model's skin details are visible. Lighting changes from reflection to refraction.

image_urls.description: Upload an image file to use as input for the API (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp; Max size: 30.0MB)

aspect_ratio.description: Required. Width-height ratio of the image, determining its visual form.

quality.description: Required. Basic outputs 1K images, while High outputs 2K images.

nsfw_checker.description: Defaults to false. When false, no additional content filtering is applied and results are returned directly by the model.

input.prompt: Keep the model's pose and the flowing shape of the liquid dress unchanged. Change the clothing material from silver metal to completely transparent clear water (or glass). Through the liquid water, the model's skin details are visible. Lighting changes from reflection to refraction.

post.description: Sent when the task succeeds or fails.

code.description: 200: success. 501: failure; see data.failCode and data.failMsg.

completeTime.description: Task completion time, represented as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

costTime.description: Processing time in seconds. Present on both success and failure callbacks.

createTime.description: Task creation time, represented as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

creditsConsumed.description: Credits consumed by the task; 0 for failed tasks.

model.description: Image-to-image model used for the task

resultJson.description: Image generation result in JSON string format. resultUrls contains the list of generated image URLs. Present only when state is success.

updateTime.description: Use completeTime as the completion time; updateTime may equal createTime.

failMsg.description: Failure reason. Present only when state is fail.

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying).

msg.description: Response message, error description upon failure

taskId.description: The task ID can be used with the "Get Task Details" endpoint to query the task status.

code.description:
Response status code

- **200**: Success - Request has been processed successfully
- **401**: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid
- **402**: Insufficient Credits - Account does not have enough credits to perform the operation
- **404**: Not Found - The requested resource or endpoint does not exist
- **408**: Timeout - No result has been returned for over 10 minutes.
- **422**: Validation Error - The request parameters failed validation checks
- **429**: Rate Limited - Request limit has been exceeded for this resource
- **455**: Service Unavailable - System is currently undergoing maintenance
- **500**: Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while processing the request
- **501**: Generation Failed - Content generation task failed
- **505**: Feature Disabled - The requested feature is currently disabled

msg.description: Response message, error description when failed

value.msg: Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while processing the request

BearerAuth.description: All API requests require a Bearer Token. Add the header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` to authenticate requests.
